title: Hartline residential delivery fee billed at $95 instead of $59
text: Hartline started store-direct deliveries to their new small-format stores in July, and their AP team flagged the residential delivery fee on the September invoices. We billed $95.00 per residential stop, but the July amendment they signed has it at $59.00. Load TW-90317 had two residential stops and a liftgate: we billed $255.00 in accessorials, they expect $183.00. There are about 140 of these loads so far and AP is short-paying the invoices until we fix it, so this is blocking collections. The charges come from `accessorial_total` in `accessorials.py`.
